question: Should malformed pullAudio chunks count toward the existing five-consecutive-input-error threshold that closes the Google Meet realtime bridge?
rationale: The code mechanically and consistently applies the existing cutoff, but that intentionally converts repeated malformed paired-node output into active bridge termination and therefore needs the Google Meet lifecycle owner's acceptance.

options.title: Count malformed chunks
options.body: Treat malformed audio as an input failure, preserve the five-error cutoff, refresh the branch, and merge after exact-head validation.

options.title: Reject without shutdown
options.body: Drop malformed chunks and warn without incrementing the shutdown counter, requiring a small behavior change and revised cutoff tests before merge.

recommendation.title: Count malformed chunks
recommendation.body: Treat malformed audio as an input failure, preserve the five-error cutoff, refresh the branch, and merge after exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history ties this person to landing and maintaining adjacent Google Meet realtime lifecycle behavior.
